import pandas as pd

file_path = '/data/asha_ngo_finances_FY25-26.xlsx'

# Load sheets
transactions = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Transactions')
budget = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Budget vs Actual')

print("Transactions columns:", transactions.columns.tolist())
print("Transactions head:")
print(transactions.head())

print("\nBudget columns:", budget.columns.tolist())
print("Budget head:")
print(budget.head())

# Compute spend per program
spend_per_program = transactions.groupby('Program')['Amount (INR)'].sum().reset_index()
print("\nSpend per program:")
print(spend_per_program)

# Merge with budget
merged = pd.merge(budget, spend_per_program, on='Program', how='left')
merged['Amount (INR)'] = merged['Amount (INR)'].fillna(0)
merged['Spend minus Budget'] = merged['Amount (INR)'] - merged['Annual budget (INR)']
print("\nMerged:")
print(merged[['Program','Annual budget (INR)','Amount (INR)','Spend minus Budget']])

# Find program with largest spend minus budget
idx_max = merged['Spend minus Budget'].idxmax()
max_program = merged.loc[idx_max, 'Program']
max_value = merged.loc[idx_max, 'Spend minus Budget']
print("\nMax program:", max_program, max_value)

import pandas as pd
file_path = '/data/asha_ngo_finances_FY25-26.xlsx'
transactions = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Transactions')
budget = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Budget vs Actual')

# Create effective program name
def map_program(row):
    prog = row['Program']
    cat = row['Category']
    if prog == 'Organisation-wide':
        if cat == 'Admin':
            return 'Admin (organisation-wide)'
        elif cat == 'Fundraising':
            return 'Fundraising (organisation-wide)'
        else:
            return prog
    else:
        return prog

transactions['Effective Program'] = transactions.apply(map_program, axis=1)

spend = transactions.groupby('Effective Program')['Amount (INR)'].sum().reset_index()
print(spend)

merged = pd.merge(budget, spend, left_on='Program', right_on='Effective Program', how='left')
merged['Amount (INR)'] = merged['Amount (INR)'].fillna(0)
merged['Spend minus Budget'] = merged['Amount (INR)'] - merged['Annual budget (INR)']
print(merged[['Program','Annual budget (INR)','Amount (INR)','Spend minus Budget']])

# Find max positive spend minus budget
max_row = merged.loc[merged['Spend minus Budget'].idxmax()]
print("\nMax:", max_row['Program'], max_row['Spend minus Budget'])
